title: Parts 1, 2 and 3 of the Portuguese version of ISO Standard 19650 published

content:
In May, the IPQ published the Portuguese version of parts 1, 2 and 3 of ISO Standard 19650, which are now available as Portuguese Standards NP EN ISO 19650-1, NP EN ISO 19650-2 and NP EN ISO 19650-3 on its website here.

These final versions of the Standards are the result of a lot of translation and revision work by the members of TC 197 – BIM, in which the BUILT CoLAB team participated. As the coordinating Sector Standardisation Body of TC 197 – BIM, BUILT CoLAB would like to thank everyone involved for their participation and contribution!

CT 197 – BIM is already starting to prepare the next working groups, which aim to continue transposing international directives into the Portuguese regulatory reality.
